title: NeoResearch: Literature- and Experience-Guided Autonomous Time Series Model Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2611.18235v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Developing effective forecasting models for diverse time-series domains requires substantial expert knowledge, evidence from scientific literature on the web, and iterative experimentation. However, translating this knowledge and research experience into model designs requires preserving source context and testing applicability under task-specific assumptions. In this paper, we propose NeoResearch, a literature- and experience-guided autonomous research framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) as researchers to discover lightweight, domain-specific forecasting models. Specifically, NeoResearch establishes an expert-inspired dual-loop research workflow, coupling hypothesis-driven architecture exploration with iterative training and hyperparameter optimization through experimental feedback. translated_title: NeoResearch：文献与经验引导的自主时间序列模型发现
translated_abstract: 为多样化的时间序列领域开发有效的预测模型，需要大量的专家知识、来自网络科学文献的证据以及反复的实验迭代。然而，将这些知识和研究经验转化为模型设计，需要保留源上下文，并在任务特定假设下检验其适用性。在本文中，我们提出了 NeoResearch，一个文献与经验引导的自主研究框架，它利用大语言模型（LLM）作为“研究者”来发现轻量级、面向特定领域的预测模型。具体而言，NeoResearch 建立了受专家启发的双循环研究工作流，将假设驱动的架构探索与基于实验反馈的迭代训练和超参数优化相结合。为实现基于知识的发现，该智能体自主从网络中挖掘科学文献，提取建模机制……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: NeoResearch 提出了一个文献与经验引导的自主研究框架，利用大语言模型充当“研究者”，通过结合假设驱动架构探索与迭代训练及超参数优化的双循环工作流，自主挖掘网络科学文献并发现轻量级、领域定制的时间序列预测模型。
en_tdlr: NeoResearch is a literature- and experience-guided autonomous research framework that employs LLMs as researchers, using an expert-inspired dual-loop workflow coupling hypothesis-driven architecture exploration with iterative training and hyperparameter optimization to autonomously mine scientific literature and discover lightweight, domain-specific time series forecasting models.
